开发模板：按开关记录配置摘要，展示设置分类、管理状态与一次性操作。不是 ROM: Development template: records a configuration summary while its switch is on, and shows settings categories, management status and one-time actions. It is not a ROM adaptation plugin.
说明页申请所需作用域并按需重启。设置页启用插件后，可开启自动记录并修改备注；管理: Request the needed scopes on the About page and restart them when asked. After enabling the plugin on the Settings page you can turn on automatic recording and change the note; the Manage page shows the latest record and saves it by hand. Disabling the plugin stops recording; the existing record is kept for the next time it is enabled.
